subject_session: Achilles-10252013, Cicero-09012014, Cicero-09172014, Gatsby-08022013, Buddy-06272013 (4 rats, 5 linear-track sessions); figures 1-6 show Achilles-10252013

headline_stat.name: median circular-linear phase-position slope among significantly precessing fields (deg/field); 114/199 fitted fields significant, 104 of those negative; 199/277 fields theta-entrained (72%)

stated_limitation: The other three sessions used a circular maze whose linearized coordinate wraps around, which would require different field-detection logic, and were skipped. ... The absolute value of the preferred phase depends on recording depth, since the theta wave reverses across the CA1 layers, and one session (`Buddy-06272013`) indeed sits about 150 deg away from the other four; it is the clustering within a session, not the numerical value across sessions, that is the result.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki dorsal CA1, hc-11) on the linear track is the canonical dataset for theta entrainment and precession, and the agent used five linear-track sessions from four rats rather than one.
justification.handling: Real data streamed over LINDI with correct per-channel LFP reads, a documented fix for the SpatialSeries storing period in the `rate` field, excitatory-only unit selection, a 5 cm/s speed threshold, direction-separated laps, and explicit peak-rate/spatial-information/field-contiguity criteria.
justification.analysis: Kempter et al. (2012) circular-linear regression with a 1000-shuffle permutation null, Rayleigh tests against a spike-jitter control, circular statistics throughout, and an explicit threshold-independence check (82% of all 199 fitted fields negative, Wilcoxon p = 9e-15); no multiple-comparison correction on per-field tests is the only gap, and the headline claim does not rest on it.
justification.correctness: Every reported number reproduces exactly from the committed `all_sessions_fields.csv` (199/277 = 71.8% entrained, 114/199 = 57.3% precessing, 104/114 = 91.2% negative, median slope -198 deg/field = -3.46 rad, median rho -0.32), and all fall inside the preregistered ranges.
justification.figures: Figures are labeled with units and sample sizes, the trough-triggered average validates the phase convention, single-field examples are ranked by circular-linear correlation (the effect strength, not fitted slope), and the pooled phase-position density plus the -223 deg population phase advance show the effect plainly; the only nit is that figures 3-6 are one session while the README quotes pooled numbers without saying so.
justification.honesty: Claims track the evidence, the excluded circular-maze sessions and the depth-dependent phase outlier session are named explicitly, and the threshold-independence check is volunteered; the one unmentioned caveat is that Buddy-06272013's own within-session phase clustering is not significant (R = 0.23, p = 0.23) even though the text asserts within-session clustering is the result.
justification.verdict: Multi-session, correctly controlled, fully reproducible from the committed artifacts, with both phenomena visible in the figures; I would take this result and move on.
